qualityChecks.subtitle: Inspect production lots and samples: open, start, then close with the result and quantities.
qualityChecks.createFirst: Create a check or change the filters.
qualityChecks.createSubtitle: The code is generated and the check starts open; the result is recorded when it closes.

hints.locked: This check is closed or cancelled and cannot be edited.
hints.orderStatuses: Orders in progress, on hold or completed can be inspected.
hints.optionalOrder: Linking an order is optional for this type.
hints.quantityLater: The quantity can be left for when the check closes.
hints.reinspection: A reinspection can be opened on an order in progress, on hold or completed, and also on a closed order to measure its retained samples (e.g. for a certificate after shipment).

rejections.title: Rejections from this check
rejections.hint: Closing with a rejected quantity opens a rejection awaiting a decision.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel check
cancelDialog.text: Cancelling is final. Give the reason.

closeDialog.title: Close the check with its result
closeDialog.text: Closing is final. Accepted + rejected = inspected.
closeDialog.acceptedWithRejected: An accepted result cannot have a rejected quantity.
closeDialog.rejectedWithout: A rejected result needs a rejected quantity.
closeDialog.rejectionHint: A rejection for the rejected quantity will open, awaiting a disposition.
closeDialog.measurementsPending: {count} parameters of the plan are not measured yet.
closeDialog.measurementsFailed: {count} parameters failed: the result cannot be accepted.

qualityChecks.qtyConstraint: Accepted plus rejected must equal the inspected quantity (above zero).

defects.sectionSubtitle: Record defects found during this quality inspection.
defects.empty: No defects have been recorded for this check
defects.statusGuardMessage: Defects cannot be added to a closed quality check

validation.defectCountMin: Defect count must be at least 1

defects.onePerType: Add every defect type found; each type is recorded once per inspection with how many times it was found.
defects.saveDefects: {count, plural, one {Record the defect} other {Record # defects}}

errors.DEFECT_ALREADY_RECORDED: This defect type is already recorded on this inspection; change its count instead.

qualityRejections.subtitle: Rejected quantities, their disposition (hold, scrap, rework…) and its execution.
qualityRejections.createFirst: Rejections open automatically when a check closes with a rejected quantity.

hints.blocksClose: The order cannot close until this rejection has a final decision.
hints.locked: This rejection has a decision and can no longer be edited.
hints.fromCheck: From a closed check; its rejected quantity is {quantity}, which its rejections cannot exceed.
hints.manual: A manual rejection for an order in progress, on hold or completed, without a check.
hints.pendingBlocks: Awaiting a disposition; the order cannot close before a final decision.
hints.holdBlocks: The quantity is on hold; hold is not final and the order cannot close until it changes.

qualityRejections.createSubtitle: The code is generated and the rejection starts awaiting a decision.
qualityRejections.executedMessage: This disposition is executed and final.

executeDialog.title: Record execution
executeDialog.text: Confirm the "{disposition}" disposition was carried out. This is final.

decideDialog.title: Disposition
decideDialog.text: The decision can change until it is executed.

dispositionHints.hold: Quarantine until a final decision; blocks closing the order.
dispositionHints.rework: The quantity is reworked and inspected again.
dispositionHints.return_to_process: The quantity returns to an earlier process step.
dispositionHints.use_as_is: Used as is under an approved concession; needs the approver and justification.

defects.title: Defects
defects.none: No defects were recorded on this inspection.
defects.overlapHint: One unit may carry several defects, so the affected quantities are shown per defect and never added up.
defects.affectedTooHigh: An affected quantity cannot be more than the rejected quantity.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

errors.PRODUCTION_ORDER_REQUIRED: Choose the production order being inspected.

errors.ORDER_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: The chosen line does not belong to this order.

errors.CHECK_NOT_OPEN: Only an open check can be started. Refresh the page.

errors.CHECK_HAS_NO_REJECTED_QUANTITY: A rejection needs a closed check with a rejected quantity.
errors.QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_CHECK: The quantity exceeds what remains of the check's rejected quantity ({available}).
errors.NOTES_REQUIRED: Write the reason for the rejection.
errors.DEFECT_NOT_FOUND: The chosen defect does not belong to this check.

errors.REJECTION_IS_FINAL: This rejection is executed; its decision cannot change.

errors.PARAMETER_REPEATED: The parameter appears twice in the specification.

errors.SPECIFICATION_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be changed; create a new revision.
errors.SPECIFICATION_EMPTY: Add at least one parameter before putting it into force.
errors.SPECIFICATION_IS_DRAFT: This is a draft; edit it directly.
errors.SPECIFICATION_DRAFT_EXISTS: A draft revision of this specification already exists.
errors.SPECIFICATION_NOT_ACTIVE: Only a specification in force can be applied.
errors.REQUIREMENT_REQUIRED: Write the requirement of the attribute parameter
errors.TARGET_SOURCE_INVALID: The target source is not valid
errors.ORDER_SPEC_KEY_REQUIRED: Write the order line key (e.g. width_mm)

errors.READINGS_REQUIRED_INVALID: At least one reading is required

errors.ACCEPTED_WITH_FAILED_MEASUREMENT: A parameter failed; the inspection cannot close as accepted. Choose conditional accept or rejected.

errors.CERTIFICATE_NOT_ISSUED: Only an issued certificate allows this.

errors.CUSTOMER_NOT_ON_LOT: The chosen customer is not one of this lot's customers.

errors.NOT_AN_INCOMING_INSPECTION: This inspection is not about a received lot.
errors.INCOMING_INSPECTION_NEEDS_DECISION: An incoming inspection is closed by its decision on the lot.
errors.DEFECTS_NEED_A_CHECK: Only a rejection from an inspection can name defects.
errors.AFFECTED_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_REJECTED: An affected quantity cannot be more than the rejected quantity.

orderSection.title: Quality
orderSection.hint: This order's inspections and rejections. The order cannot close while a check is open or a rejection lacks a final decision.
orderSection.blocksClose: The order cannot close until open checks are closed and every rejection has a final decision.

measurements.title: Measurement results
measurements.noPlan: This inspection has no measurement plan.
measurements.noSpecification: No specification is in force for this product.
measurements.rule: A parameter passes when every reading lies within its limits. The whole plan must be measured before closing, and an inspection with a failed parameter cannot close as accepted.
measurements.otherProductHint: This specification is for «{product}», not the order's product; make sure it applies to this batch.
measurements.missingValuesHint: The order line lacks these values the specification needs; enter them from the batch itself. They are kept on the inspection and shown in its report.
measurements.lotValues: Lot values entered by the inspector: {values}
measurements.invalidReading: Invalid reading: enter a number only (e.g. 5.02).

parameters.title: Test parameters
parameters.subtitle: What is measured in a unit (width, thickness, weight…) or checked visually (conforming / not).
parameters.emptyHint: Start with the standard strapping-band parameters, then edit them or add your own.
parameters.standardHint: Width, thickness, weight, length, break strength, elongation and the visual checks. Existing ones are left as they are.
parameters.kindHint: A parameter's kind cannot change later: specifications and inspections rely on it.

specifications.subtitle: Technical data sheets (TDS): acceptance limits per parameter, in controlled revisions.
specifications.emptyHint: Create a specification per product (and grade), then put it into force to become its inspections' measurement plan.
specifications.productHint: Write the product as it appears on production orders; a new inspection takes its product's specification in force when there is exactly one.
specifications.linesHint: The target comes from the order line's specification (e.g. width_mm) or is fixed. A written minimum or maximum takes precedence over the tolerance.
specifications.noParameters: There are no test parameters yet.
specifications.formSubtitle: Saved as a draft; inspections use it only once it is in force.
specifications.lockedHint: This specification is not a draft; revise it to change it.
specifications.activateText: This revision comes into force and replaces the previous one with the same number. Earlier inspections keep their plan.
specifications.supersededHint: This revision is superseded and kept for reference only.

certificates.subtitle: Batch quality certificates for customers (COA): prepared from a closed conforming inspection, then approved, numbered and frozen.
certificates.emptyHint: Open a closed, accepted inspection with a measurement plan, then «Prepare certificate».
certificates.draftHint: A draft is not valid to send: complete it, then «Approve and issue» to number it.
certificates.frozenHint: The results were copied from the inspection when the draft was prepared and do not change.
certificates.deviationHint: The inspection is a conditional accept: state the deviation and the customer's approval; it is printed.

issueDialog.title: Approve and issue the certificate
issueDialog.text: The certificate takes the next number and becomes final; a correction is made with a replacement.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the certificate
revokeDialog.text: Revoking is final and is printed on the certificate. Give the reason.

blockers.CHECK_NOT_CLOSED: A certificate is prepared once the inspection is closed.
blockers.CHECK_NOT_CERTIFIABLE: No certificate for an inspection that is not accepted or conditionally accepted.
blockers.CERTIFICATE_NEEDS_MEASUREMENTS: This inspection has no measurement plan; a certificate needs results measured against a specification.
blockers.CERTIFICATE_HAS_FAILED_MEASUREMENT: A parameter failed; no certificate is issued for a non-conforming batch.

settings.title: Certificate numbering
settings.hint: To continue from paper certificates, enter the last number issued; numbering never goes back.

returns.title: Returns awaiting quality
returns.subtitle: Goods customers sent back that quality inspects before any decision: one inspection per returned item.
returns.emptyHint: Returns received for quality appear here until every item is decided.
returns.batchTitle: Same production order {order}: every delivery note
returns.batchHint: Containment: who else received goods from this batch, and what is ready to leave.
returns.batchLeaving: Ready to leave from this batch: {notes}. Hold them until the decision.
returns.batchEmpty: No other delivery note carried this production order.
returns.decisionText: Split the inspected {quantity} between where each part goes; the parts add up to it.

partHints.use_as_is: Sold as it is under a concession
partHints.return_to_process: Ground and fed back to extrusion

returns.openNcr: Open a non-conformance report for the customer return

incoming.title: Incoming inspection
incoming.subtitle: Received lots of materials inspected on arrival: one inspection per lot, then its decision.
incoming.searchPlaceholder: Receipt no., supplier, material or lot
incoming.emptyHint: Received lots of materials marked “inspected on arrival” appear here until each is decided.
incoming.decisionText: Split the inspected {quantity}: what is released for use, and where the rest goes; the parts add up to it.

partHints.use_as_is: Out of specification, accepted under a concession
partHints.sort: Sorted, the good part inspected again

incoming.ncrNotice: What is not released opens a non-conformance report about the supplier.
